author: Zintenka
body:
A topic based on a lot of my maps that I REALLY feel that are worthy of repair.

VTOL My first ever map to get accepted. But unused because of a broken YML.

Coup de'tat One of my most prized maps with a unique (I think) style.

Ka-Boom! A very great map! The debut of my TNT heavy maps :P

War Everlasting One of my greater maps that focus solely on gameplay but with an ugly, natural, block palette. Hey, it was accepted for it catering to great gameplay.

War Everlasting II Sequel to War Everlasting, TNT heavy folks.

Battleship Warz I Going to check if YML is already valid as this is fairly recent

Battleship Warz II ^

Maps with links have had their YML repaired.
